construction: One deterministic irreversible deletion point per expert. Replace the V rows and their bias, Attention output matrix/bias, both MLP matrices/bias in target-selected layers with the public pretrained values. Preserve Q/K, LayerNorm, heads and all other parameters. No noise, rank choice, gradients, optimization, calibration fitting or future partner access during construction.
novelty: Task-vector masking and pretrained replacement are existing tools. This is a full recovery/tradeoff diagnostic of a known favorable training point, not a new algorithm or established defense.
standard_protocol: All eight official experts, TA 0.2, unchanged public task heads. Only the target release is processed by original author AGA. Whole-network Attention and MLP replacement and public spectral deletion receive identical unprotected controls. Three official test sets are evaluated, not an eight-task mean or AGA Table 6 reproduction.
spectral_attack: From the accessible release minus public pretrained, delete the largest rank-one task-update component in every visual V, Attention-output and MLP matrix. Skip exactly zero updates. Bias remains unchanged. No secret defender direction, original target expert, calibration data, rank sweep or fitting.
adaptive_weight_attack: Set target effective fusion weight to exactly 1, with all other seven weights fixed at 0.2. Implement as five times the accessible target task vector followed by unchanged author TA. No coefficient search. Report target and partners with matched unprotected reweighting controls.
functional_attack: Use 256 fixed public target training images, query only hard predictions from each accessible teacher release, and read CLS features from its own direct merged student. Reuse existing anchor-centered ridge_update and head right inverse to compile pseudo-label responses into the unchanged visual.proj. Reconstruct the target projection algebraically so author TA realizes that merged projection. No teacher hidden activations, original target parameters for protected recovery, true calibration labels or optimizer steps. Single fit and fixed ridge; not complete SLOA.
attacker_data: Use the first 256 target training selection indices from the already inspected task-profile parent. They overlap prior selection intentionally; official tests are never used for attack fitting. No claim of fresh calibration or unbiased validation.
reporting: Run every fixed attack unconditionally. Report standalone utility, all three merged test accuracies, best tested target recovery and paired unprotected control. Best includes direct use. Also report partner changes, so high target recovery with lost partner utility is visible. No fixed accuracy acceptance or stopping gate; no tuning after tests.
